gloss: to add in writing; to write more

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {書|か}き{足|た}しませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {書|か}き{足|た}していなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {書|か}き{足|た}していませんでした

definitions.gloss: to add in writing; to write more
definitions.explanation: To supplement existing text by writing additional content.

examples.japanese: {報告書|ほうこくしょ}に{補足|ほそく}を{書|か}き{足|た}した。
examples.english: I added a supplement to the report.

examples.japanese: {先生|せんせい}に{言|い}われて、{説明|せつめい}を{書|か}き{足|た}した。
examples.english: I added more explanation as the teacher told me to.

examples.japanese: {日記|にっき}に{昨日|きのう}の{出来事|できごと}を{書|か}き{足|た}す。
examples.english: I'll add yesterday's events to my diary.

examples.japanese: {申込書|もうしこみしょ}に{連絡先|れんらくさき}を{書|か}き{足|た}すように{言|い}われた。
examples.english: I was told to add my contact information to the application form.

examples.japanese: {手紙|てがみ}の{最後|さいご}に「また{会|あ}いましょう」と{書|か}き{足|た}した。
examples.english: I added "let's meet again" at the end of the letter.

notes:
A compound verb meaning to add something in writing to what already exists. From {書|か}く (to write) + {足|た}す (to add/supplement).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Takes を for the content added: {説明|せつめい}を{書|か}き{足|た}す
- Takes に for where it's added: メモに{書|か}き{足|た}す

ASPECT (ている):
{書|か}き{足|た}している means "is in the process of adding" (ongoing action).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {文章|ぶんしょう}を{書|か}き{足|た}す (to add to a text)
- {理由|りゆう}を{書|か}き{足|た}す (to add reasons in writing)
- メモに{書|か}き{足|た}す (to add to notes)
- {一言|ひとこと}{書|か}き{足|た}す (to add a brief note)

THE ～{足|た}す PATTERN:
The auxiliary verb {足|た}す means "to add/supplement" and creates compound verbs:
- {言|い}い{足|た}す (to add verbally)
- {付|つ}け{足|た}す (to append, to add on)
- {買|か}い{足|た}す (to buy additional items)
